name: @avandar/ava-video-producer
description: Avandar workspace video producer, component previews, Motion Atlas, and sample films

scripts.adopt: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/adoptTheme/adoptTheme.ts
scripts.preview: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && sh scripts/preview.sh demo
scripts.render: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && sh scripts/render.sh demo
scripts.check: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/checkFrames.ts out/demo.mp4
scripts.showcase: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/yaml/registerYaml.ts scripts/showcase/server/server.ts
scripts.typecheck: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/yaml/registerYaml.ts scripts/testing/runProducerTests.ts
scripts.video: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/yaml/registerYaml.ts scripts/video/video.ts
scripts.capture: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/captureAvandar/captureAvandar.ts
scripts.preview:showcase: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && PREVIEW_ONLY=1 sh scripts/render-showcase.sh
scripts.capture:curate: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/curateCapture/curateCapture.ts
scripts.component:build: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/buildProduct/buildProduct.ts
scripts.component:review: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/reviewAvandar.ts
scripts.motion:build: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/yaml/registerYaml.ts scripts/showcase/buildShowcaseCli.ts
scripts.motion: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/yaml/registerYaml.ts scripts/motion/motion.ts
scripts.component:measure: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/measureAvandar/measureAvandar.ts
scripts.component:deliver: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/deliverAvandar.ts
scripts.video:new: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/newVideo.ts
scripts.component:watch: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/buildProduct/buildProduct.ts --watch
scripts.pretest: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx scripts/buildProduct/buildProduct.ts
scripts.pretypecheck: node --import tsx scripts/requireLicense.ts && node --import tsx --import ./scripts/yaml/registerYaml.ts scripts/showcase/buildShowcaseCli.ts
